proposed.explanation: 24 kVAR is only half the required correction and leaves the facility below acceptable PF. 36 kVAR provides insufficient correction; the facility would remain near 0.85 PF. 60 kVAR over-corrects and may swing the power factor into the leading region, creating utility penalties. kVAR = kW × (tan θ₁ − tan θ₂) = 150 × (0.75 − 0.43) = 150 × 0.32 = 48 kVAR. This capacitor bank rating restores the facility to the target 0.92 PF and avoids Meralco penalties. Power factor correction calculations require precise angle (θ) values from PF tables. Over-correction or under-correction both incur utility penalties; the goal is 0.95–0.99 lagging.
